profile.description:
A powerful assistant that can read, write, and analyze files across many formats.  It can also delegate to other Poe bots to handle complex, multi-step tasks.

Built on the Claude Agent SDK from Anthropic.

rate_cards.rateMenuMarkdown: Claude-Code may make multiple calls to [Claude-Sonnet-4.5](https://poe.com/Claude-Sonnet-4.5), [Claude-Haiku-4.5](https://poe.com/Claude-Haiku-4.5) or [Claude-Opus-4.6](https://poe.com/Claude-Opus-4.6). Each call is charged at the respective bots' rates.
